relations.rationale: Laughing about a reading list mix-up has no bearing on relative heights of Milo and Nell.
Milo being taller than Nell says nothing about Isla's height relative to Nell.
Height comparison between Milo and Nell has no connection to Finn bringing snacks.
Milo's height relative to Nell is unrelated to his sharing thoughts on a protagonist.

General agreement nodding doesn't relate to Milo later sharing his own thoughts.

The rain stopping is unrelated to the group's decision to meet again next week.
